newsitem.title: IRAN: Rafsanjani sees no thaw in Iran-U.S ties.
newsitem.headline: Rafsanjani sees no thaw in Iran-U.S ties.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Wednesday said that an end to his term in August was unlikely to ease strained relations with the United States.
"I do not predict any change in the relations, or a different prospect from that of the present time," the official Iranian news agency IRNA quoted Rafsanjani as telling a news conference in Tehran.
Iran's ties with the United States have been strained since the 1979 Islamic revolution led by the late Ayotallah Ruhollah Khomeini.

Washington, which has launched an economic and political campaign to isolate Iran, accuses Tehran of supporting international terrorism, seeking to obtain nuclear weapons and threatening the security of neighbouring Gulf Arab states.
Iran denies the charges and accuses Washington of stoking tensions to justify its military presence in the oil-rich region.
